descriptionText:
Pulp Fantastic #1 (of 3) (February 2000, DC / Vertigo V2K) -- Howard Chaykin and David Tischman story, Rick Burchett art, from Vertigo's V2K line. Direct sales edition. Back cover carries the Capcom Resident Evil 3 Nemesis PlayStation ad. Cover price $2.50 US.

Condition: Very Good. Cover clean and glossy with light handling wear. Please review the photos - they are of the actual copy you will receive.
